subject: Where is our order SO-5001?

body: We ordered 400 ESD boxes on SO-5002 but only 300 arrived on 11 Nov. Is the rest coming? Our production line needs them next week. Contact: logistics@saimaa-electronics.example

subject: Invoice INV-7003 does not match quote
